exposure: high intake of animal protein and lipids
high intake of plant protein, fiber, and carbohydrates
outcome: composition and diversity of breast milk microbiota
finding: Maternal diet, particularly fiber and protein intake, shapes the composition and diversity of breast milk microbiota, with mode of delivery and antibiotic exposure showing an interaction effect.
mod_finding: Differences in breast milk microbiota were found between maternal dietary clusters in the cesarean-section/antibiotic group, whereas no differences were observed in vaginal births.
